These are unchanged native ORCA 6.1.1 scientific text outputs, inputs, exported
basis bytes and receipts for a frozen He2 five-leg counterpoise calculation.
No ORCA executable, installation archive or wavefunction binary is included.

Source: https://github.com/ProfJJK-CoChem/CoChem-BASE/actions/runs/37666938546
GitHub artifact ID: 11509101361
Original artifact ZIP SHA-256:
72ebf75b7832088d4aa803eec3f29ce36ac1deb54ce62e18e37fed2e7c181d19
Original TOPOS source: 65af1e05ce505cac5911b1bfe8f985a26dd87864
The provenance.json file records BASE/TORQ identities, each retained raw member
checksum, and the checksum of the unchanged counterpoise-result.json receipt.
Some filenames have .txt appended for source distribution inclusion. Test
wrappers restore original basenames without changing the raw scientific bytes.

The tests create explicitly labeled wrapper RunStores solely to verify offline
import, immutable membership, portability and rejection of scientific tampering.
These historical parser fixtures cannot pass the current-source reviewed matrix
campaign, an independent literature comparison, or any physical release gate.
The He2 native result is not a published reference value or an accuracy target.

Imported observable: E_complex(complex basis) - E_A(complex basis)
- E_B(complex basis), all evaluated at the same predeclared frozen complex
geometry. The two own-basis monomer legs also establish the separate raw
interaction and additive CP correction. Half-CP is a distinct convention.
No relaxation, zero-point, thermal or solvation contribution is imported.

Method definition: Boys and Bernardi, Molecular Physics 19, 553-566 (1970),
https://doi.org/10.1080/00268977000101561
Native ghost syntax and basis file documentation:
https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/essentialelements/counterpoise.html
https://www.faccts.de/docs/orca/6.1/manual/contents/essentialelements/basisset.html

Retained checksums and internally consistent BASE receipts establish content
integrity and provenance consistency. They are not independent authentication
of arbitrarily supplied records, independent timestamping or scientific review.
